rule_atoms.rule_shape: Invoice lines whose variance against the matching order exceeds the tolerance for their spend band are opened as exceptions and put on payment hold, except lines carrying an authorised variance approval note.

chain: read the policy worksheet to learn the business rule

scan the invoice lines (purchase order reference, invoiced amount, received quantity, ordered quantity, tolerance band) and select the ones the rule applies to; at least 3 look-alike records must be skipped
for each selected record: create_or_update_issue in mantisbt, update_cell in directus
finish with one summary: post_channel in zulip
